OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rocco Wojcik is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Rocco Wojcik is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Rocco kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Rocco's gone." Tuilelaith looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Rocco." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ingrid blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
"OH! OH! PRECISE MEND! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Rocco Wojcik, 69 days. The mantle passes to Ingrid Vik.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ingrid Vik, 35 — a physical therapy aide. Her hands know different work now: The Touch.
The village's quarrel was with Rocco — and Rocco is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Esther, Cheyenne, Tuilelaith and 4 more speak for Ingrid — "Rocco trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Ingrid before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
